items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: and then the next time was Chano Pozo, so we made like a jam session, tambores, you know, congas, bongos, timbales and Chano Pozo was in charge.

ctx.x: Uh - Huh. All right, now, that day that that picture was taken, Miguelito Valdes is there too. Did you just record Olga or were there other recordings done that day?

I think it was just record Olga; and then the next time was Chano Pozo, so we made like a jam session, tambores, you know, congas, bongos, timbales and Chano Pozo was in charge. That's when you really realized how much Chano knew about that style. He was a good organizer, he know what he want, he give you all the syncopation, all the things that every conga player had to do. The clave, the spoon around the conga barrel and, no no no no, he was a real pro in that particular thing.

I see. . . You were on contract to Verne records at the time. Coda released records under the name of the Rene Hernandez orchestra; in reality, it was the Machito orchestra because you were on contract too. Those recordings made with Coda, did the entire band play under the name of Rene Hernandez?
